name: Zaghum
headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | Helping Startups Build Fast, Scalable Web Applications | React | Next.js | Node.js | AI | AWS

sections.bio:
Hi, I'm Zaghum Abbas and I don't just write code. I build things people actually depend on.

Five years ago I wrote my first production app. Since then I haven't stopped shipping. Full-stack, mobile, Fintech, SaaS. I've worked across it all with teams in the US and UK, and the one thing that never changed is this: I care whether the product actually works in the real world, not just in a demo.

I've integrated payment systems with Stripe and Whop, locked down backends with JWT and OAuth, built live dashboards and real-time features using WebSockets and Socket.io, and taken mobile apps all the way through to the iOS and Android App Store. Not handed off halfway. Not "almost ready." Shipped.

The tech is the easy part honestly. What's harder and what I've gotten good at is understanding what the product actually needs, flagging problems before they become expensive, and making sure what gets built is something users come back to.

What I work with:
Frontend → React.js · Next.js · React Native · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS
Backend → Node.js · Express · GraphQL · REST APIs
Database → PostgreSQL · MongoDB · Firebase
Payments → Stripe · Whop
Auth → JWT · OAuth 2.0
Real-time → WebSockets · Socket.io
Mobile → iOS & Android Deployment

What you actually get working with me:

A developer who thinks about the product, not just the ticket
Architecture that holds up when things start scaling
Interfaces that feel right, not just look right
Honest communication early, not after it's already a problem

Open to hourly contracts, fixed-price projects, and long-term partnerships where the work actually matters.

If that sounds like what you're looking for let's talk.
